description: Create the authenticated user's personal Tineo forwarding address when they explicitly ask for one. Tineo reads email sent to that address and adds the travel bookings it finds to the user's trips, so the user can forward confirmations from any inbox or give it to a travel agent or booking site. Never replaces or changes an existing address: if one already exists it is returned unchanged. Use forwarding_address_get to read addresses without creating one.

confirmed.description: Must be true, set only after the user explicitly asks to create a forwarding address.

name: forwarding_address_create
title: Create Forwarding Address
